description: Historical: the TUI calls `exit/1` when its monitored session goes down, so a controlled session shutdown crashes the terminal app instead of stopping it and reporting the failure. The code was later reworked (9b65826 renamed the reason to `:agent_down`) and the behaviour fixed in a502e4f ("fix: subagent crashes when stopping session").

issues.description: The `:DOWN` handler for the session exits the TUI process with `{:session_down, reason}`, crashing the app (and its terminal state) on any session stop instead of shutting down cleanly and reporting the error.
